BEGIN PRE-AUDIT OFFER SNAPSHOT (HISTORICAL; NOT CURRENT STOCK)
STORE FINDINGS - COLOMBO PHONE OFFERS
Related files: phone_search.txt = needs/models; phone_instructions.txt = rules; phone_logs.txt = history.
Updated organization: 17 October 2026, Asia/Colombo.
Prices in LKR. Existing web findings last researched 17 October 2026 around 16:30.
Daily refresh at 08:00 Asia/Colombo. Ascending suitability rank: #1 best offer.
Separate cash-price index below. All stock/testing/warranty claims need the
verification status recorded with the individual offer.
CRITICAL VERIFICATION STATUS
No offer is fully purchase-qualified yet: permission to test before payment is
UNKNOWN for every seller. An order button does not prove stock, and store pickup
does not mean a shop permits opening a sealed phone before purchase.
Active candidates below have merchant product-page prices, not guaranteed stock.
Warranty display-line coverage is UNKNOWN unless later explicitly documented.
No OLED phone is guaranteed immune to display lines, including iPhones.
Get local written coverage; never assume overseas lifetime cover applies here.
KOKO approval and your available spending limit must cover the actual transaction.

ACTIVE MERCHANT CANDIDATES - PROVISIONAL SUITABILITY ORDER

#1 HONOR 400 Pro 12GB/512GB - Toyo - advertised retail/new; confirm sealed status
Cash/bank: 182,990. KOKO total: 197,629.20; 3 x 65,876.40 (8% above cash).
Why first: strongest camera/battery/performance balance to test within the cap.
Tradeoffs: compare moving subjects, indoor photos, skin tones and zoom against
your Pixel; do not assume higher megapixels mean better photos. Try MagicOS first.
Region: not established. Merchant says 6000mAh; other sellers list 5300mAh.
Inspect exact regional SKU and battery specification before ranking it as 6000mAh.
Warranty: one year advertised; page has generic official-warranty wording, but
issuer and applicable option are unconfirmed. Display-line cover unknown.
Stock: order controls shown; selected colour/warranty stock unconfirmed.
Location: Toyo, 210/10, Airtel Market, Main Street, Colombo 11.
Testing before payment: UNKNOWN. Contact published: 0777 044 881 / 0777 358 378.
Source: https://toyo.lk/product/honor-400-pro-5g-12gb-ram-512gb/

#2 OnePlus 13R 12GB/256GB - Greenware - advertised retail/new; confirm sealed status
Cash: 155,000. KOKO widget: 3 x 51,666.67; total about 155,000.01 rounding.
Why: compelling battery/performance value near the preferred budget; 6000mAh
confirmed by OnePlus specifications. Test camera carefully before leaving Pixel.
Tradeoffs: camera versatility, especially ultrawide/selfie and long zoom, may
disappoint a Pixel 7 Pro owner. Camera parity is not established by this research.
Region: unknown; exclude flashed China Ace models presented as global 13R.
Warranty: one year advertised; issuer/local enforceability and line cover unknown.
Stock: add-to-basket shown; actual shop stock unknown. KOKO final total unconfirmed.
Locations: 42 P, Ground Floor, Liberty Plaza, Colombo 03; 154 Galle Rd, Colombo 04.
Testing before payment: UNKNOWN. Contact published: 0777 648 648.
Source: https://www.greenware.lk/mobile-phones/oneplus/13r-12gb-ram-256gb-storage
Specs: https://www.oneplus.com/us/13r/specs

#3 Xiaomi 15T 12GB/512GB - Toyo - advertised retail/new; confirm sealed status
Cash FROM 163,500. Displayed KOKO total 176,580; 3 x 58,860 (8% uplift).
Important: FROM price and selectable warranty mean final chosen option can cost more.
Why: worthwhile camera/storage alternative between the first two price points.
Tradeoffs: test HyperOS preference, camera processing, notifications and hotspot
stability. Pixel camera equivalence and your battery target remain unproven.
Region: unknown. Xiaomi global specs are the reference, not copied retailer text.
Warranty: one year advertised; exact issuer/option/line cover unconfirmed.
Stock: order controls shown, chosen option unconfirmed. Test-before-pay UNKNOWN.
Location/contact: Toyo, Colombo 11, as above.
Source: https://toyo.lk/product/xiaomi-mi-15t-5g-12gb-ram-512gb/
Specs: https://www.mi.com/global/product/xiaomi-15t/specs/

#4 OnePlus 13R 16GB/512GB - Greenware - advertised retail/new; confirm sealed status
Cash 192,000. KOKO widget 3 x 64,000 = 192,000; checkout total unconfirmed.
Why: more storage, useful for frequent video; lower value than #2 if 256GB is enough.
Same camera, region and local warranty verification needs as #2.
Stock: merchant listing, actual availability unknown. One-year warranty advertised.
Location: Greenware Colombo 03/04 as above. Test-before-pay UNKNOWN.
Source: https://www.greenware.lk/mobile-phones/oneplus/13r-16gb-ram-512gb-storage

#5 Nothing Phone (3a) Pro 12GB/256GB - Toyo - retail/new; confirm sealed status
Cash 145,000. KOKO total 156,600; 3 x 52,200 (8% uplift).
Why: lower-cost alternative if OS feel matters; try its camera in person.
Tradeoffs: do not treat this midrange model as a guaranteed Pixel flagship
performance or camera replacement. Lower priority for demanding camera/hotspot use.
Region: exact SKU unknown; listing says TRCSL. One-year warranty advertised,
issuer and line cover unknown. Order controls shown; actual stock unknown.
Location/contact: Toyo Colombo 11 as above. Test-before-pay UNKNOWN.
Source: https://toyo.lk/product/nothing-phone-3a-pro-12gb-ram-256gb/

ASCENDING CASH-PRICE INDEX - ACTIVE CANDIDATES
145,000 - Nothing Phone (3a) Pro 256GB, Toyo (#5)
155,000 - OnePlus 13R 256GB, Greenware (#2)
163,500 FROM - Xiaomi 15T 512GB, Toyo (#3; option price unconfirmed)
182,990 - Honor 400 Pro 512GB, Toyo (#1)
192,000 - OnePlus 13R 512GB, Greenware (#4)

WATCHLIST - NOT VERIFIED ACTIVE DEALS

W1 Used iPhone 15 Plus 256GB - advertised 175,000, Colombo 3.
This is the first Apple model I would investigate for your battery/camera balance.
Search index says posted 16 October; direct listing retrieval failed.
Seller identity/address, battery health, repairs, stock, warranty, KOKO and testing
permission are all UNKNOWN. Do not pay based on the indexed advertisement.
Target battery health >=90% as a buying preference, with corroborating history.
60Hz screen and no dedicated telephoto are compromises versus Pixel 7 Pro.
Check USB-C convenience, video, shutter response and whether iOS suits your workflow.
Source lead: https://ikman.lk/en/ad/apple-iphone-15-plus-256gb-used-for-sale-colombo-227
Apple specifications: https://support.apple.com/en-us/111830

W2 OnePlus 15R 12GB/256GB - Greenware, product page 193,000; category 194,000.
Promising battery/performance candidate, but seller descriptions are inconsistent
across variants and exact regional hardware needs checking. Global specs page
could not be extracted. Do not infer camera quality or KOKO total from vague text.
KOKO category widget 3 x 64,666.67; reconcile with actual variant price first.
One-year warranty/region/display cover/stock/test-before-pay unconfirmed.
Location: Greenware Colombo 03/04 above.
Source: https://www.greenware.lk/mobile-phones/oneplus/oneplus-15r-5g
Category: https://www.greenware.lk/mobile-phones/oneplus

W3 Used iPhone 15 - Present Solution, 155,000-175,000 across variants.
KOKO shown. Exact 256GB price, battery health, repairs, warranty, shop address and
test-before-pay unknown. Smaller phone is less aligned with the battery priority.
Source: https://presentsolution.lk/product/iphone-15-pre-owned/

W4 Used iPhone 15 Pro - Present Solution, 200,000-245,000 across variants.
Starting price alone is not a confirmed affordable 256GB unit. KOKO shown.
Prefer Plus/Pro Max investigation for endurance; do not buy Pro just for the name.
Source: https://presentsolution.lk/product-category/pre-owned-phones-in-sri-lanka/mobile-phones/iphone/pre-owned-iphone-15-series-in-sri-lanka/

W5 Samsung Galaxy S25 256GB - under-budget aggregator leads 198,500-198,900,
but merchant Present Solution page showed 203,999 (over budget), KOKO displayed.
Do not treat aggregator quotes as live inventory. Compact model is a lower
battery-priority choice for all-day navigation/hotspot/camera. Check S24+/S25+
and used Ultra variants only with verified price/condition and local warranty.
Merchant: https://presentsolution.lk/product/samsung-galaxy-s25-sri-lanka/
Lead: https://www.ideabeam.com/Mobile/product-amp/samsung-galaxy-s25-256gb-price.html

W6 Vivo V60 12GB/256GB - Toyo adjacent-product link advertises 179,740;
actual product page blocked by bot verification. Camera/battery-oriented model
worth investigating, but no verified full offer or KOKO terms obtained today.
Source lead: https://toyo.lk/product/vivo-v60-5g-12gb-ram-256gb/

W7 Oppo Reno 14 F 12GB/512GB - Toyo 149,740 cash; 161,719.20 KOKO,
3 x 53,906.40. Lower-priority alternative: do not exchange flagship camera and
performance for battery capacity alone. Stock, exact SKU and testing unknown.
Source: https://toyo.lk/product/oppo-reno-14-f-5g-12gb-ram-512gb/

W8 Newer Honor 600 Pro: SimplyTek listing approximately 310,000 before its
displayed service fee; outside cap. Monitor reductions rather than stretch budget.
Source: https://www.simplytek.lk/collections/all/products/honor-600-pro-smartphone

U7 User-shown iPhone 16 256GB: asking 195,000, 89% health, 369 cycles,
